doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Marriage to John T. McClain Sr. in 1948
summary: Her first marriage lasted about fifteen years; he went on the road with her and wanted her to play free in his club.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: 1948 you married your first husband. You didn’t mention by name yesterday, would you do that?
And that marriage lasted how long?
Were there any good times with him that you want to document?
No, it looked like I did all the work. And he just went on the road with me.
To what extent did he try to navigate your business decisions? Did he serve as your manager at any time?
No, he wanted me to play in his club free.
